title: Python + MT5: Build an H1 Model and Replay 74 EURUSD Positions
description:
A practical walkthrough of a permitted UTC EURUSD H1 demo export, a point-in-time feature pipeline, train-only logistic regression, chronological validation, and a retrospective bid/ask quote replay of frozen decisions. The +$1,209 quote result is before unknown historical swap; additional slippage is assumed zero. This is not an account-wide net result or a profitability test. No live orders were sent.

Read the public, read-only CSV replay guide: https://github.com/EAPrognoz/Trading-AI-Engineering/blob/main/experiments/eurusd_h1_model_error_lab/backtest/v2/README.md

The frozen model, predictions, and raw historical quote files are private and are not included. The public runner works with your own authorized decision and quote CSVs; it will produce different values.
